Built and analysed a 2D spine-beam model of the 3-span cast-in-place continuous box-girder unit (32+40+32 m, deck 16 m).

Modelling decisions (all evidence-backed):
- idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05, pier column geometry is given).
- Girder: cast-in-place single-cell box, section integrated to A = 8.210 m², I = 4.690 m⁴ (MR-02); Ec = 34500 MPa for C50 (JTG3362-3.1.5); owner-required γ = 26.5 kN/m³ (MR-00 override), giving w = 217.57 kN/m and m = 22.18 t/m (MR-07).
- Supports (2 bearings per line, MR-04): Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 1 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh = 0); Pier 2 = plain elastomeric (longitudinally spring, Kh = 10909 kN/m). Vertical stiffness from the laminated-elastomeric formulas (MR-03, JTG3362-8.7): Kv ≈ 3.142e6 (abutments), 6.616e6 (Pier 1), 7.777e6 kN/m (Pier 2), with S = 10.10, 13.54, 14.69 respectively. Rotation free at all lines.
- Piers: twin circular C40 columns, D = 1.6 m, fixed at base (MR-06, JTG3362-3.1.5): A = 4.021 m², I = 0.643 m⁴, Ec = 32500 MPa; Pier 1 length 14 m, Pier 2 length 6 m.
- Live load (JTG D60-2015 Class I): 4 design lanes, ξ = 0.67, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 324/340/324 kN for the three spans; impact factor μ = 0.1964 from f1 = 3.322 Hz (JTG3362-4.3.2).

Results: first three vertical frequencies 3.32/4.92/5.77 Hz; self-weight support reactions ≈ 2601/8699/8743/2584 kN; lane-load maximum positive moment 11214 kN·m and negative moment −8759 kN·m. All topology, code and mechanics checks passed.
